proposals.rationale: Paragraph (b)(1)(ii) contains an embedded condition qualifying permission C0001: an authorization is permitted to contain additional elements or information only provided that they are not inconsistent with the required elements. In accordance with the relationship pass instructions, this qualification must be represented as a companion condition record qualifying C0001 with prerequisite relation and not_stated modality, preserving C0001 as the baseline permission.

observations.rationale: The baseline non-modifier rule that requires or permits disclosures pursuant to a valid authorization is located in 45 CFR 164.508(a)(1), which is outside the focus text. Because the baseline duty or permission is remote and not present among the supplied draft claims, the qualification target for the defective authorization conditions in paragraph (b)(2) is genuinely unavailable and remains unresolved.
